scripts.text: I came here to become to a Ranger.
I just came to look around.
The weather is really great. Shall we take a picture to commemorate it?
scripts.translation: 天气真好啊。要不要拍张照留念一下？

scripts.text: Then just look around quietly and then go back.
scripts.translation: 那就安静地看看，然后回去吧。

scripts.text: Well, it's a passing mark that you recognize me... let me see.
scripts.translation: 嗯，能认出我，这一点算你及格...让我看看。

scripts.text: I can tell just by looking at you that you seem to be inexperienced.
scripts.translation: 光看你的样子，我就知道你很缺乏经验。

scripts.text: Have more pride in your job and get more experience, and then when you grow as a Hunter or a Sniper you can make an aura by yourself, please come back again.
scripts.translation: 拿出身为猎人或神射手的自豪，多积累些经验。等你练到满级，身上散发出光环时，再来找我吧。

scripts.text: First of all, let me tell you the job change qualifications to be a Ranger.
scripts.translation: 我先说明一下转职为游侠所需的资格。

scripts.text: I've already checked the first qualification that you've experienced enough to make an aura as a Hunter or a Sniper.
scripts.translation: 第一项我已经确认过了：你作为猎人或神射手，已积累了足够的经验，达到了满级发光的境界。

scripts.text: For the second qualification to judge one's ability exactly, you need to lighten your body and mind.
scripts.translation: 为了准确判断你的能力，你需要减轻身体和心灵的负担。

scripts.text: When you change a job into a Ranger from a Hunter,
scripts.translation: 从猎人转职为游侠之后，

scripts.text: you won't get any chance to learn the skills of a Sniper, would that be okay?
scripts.translation: 就无法再学习神射手的技能了，这样可以吗？

scripts.text: I want to be a Ranger already.
Take your time to think, if it's okay then come back.
scripts.translation: 请慢慢考虑，如果决定好了，请回来找我。

scripts.text: Before you change into a Ranger, even though you reached the highest level of a Hunter, it is not the best evaluation of your abilities.
scripts.translation: 虽然你已将猎人练到了满级，但光凭等级，还不足以判断你有没有成为游侠的实力。

scripts.text: So in order to check your abilities, I'll need to evaluate your pure abilities.~
scripts.translation: 所以，我得考考你的真本事~

scripts.text: Before you change into a Ranger, even though you reached the highest level of a Sniper, it is not the best evaluation of your abilities.
scripts.translation: 虽然你已将神射手练到了满级，但光凭等级，还不足以判断你有没有成为游侠的实力。

scripts.text: So in order to check your abilities, I'll need to evaluate your pure abilities.~
scripts.translation: 所以，我得考考你的真本事~

scripts.text: To do this you need to be cleansed of body and soul.
scripts.translation: 要做到这一点，你需要净化身心。

scripts.text: Make sure that your weight equals '0' to continue.
scripts.translation: 请确保你的负重为“0”以继续。

scripts.text: Wow, you've come back so quickly.
Ok, now I'll talk about the requirements to take the test to become a Ranger.
scripts.translation: 好的，现在我来谈谈参加游侠考试的要求。

scripts.text: All the tests to become a Ranger are going to be done with practical means.
scripts.translation: 游侠的转职考试，全都要靠实战。

scripts.text: Will there be a written test?
The most important part of this test is the test of your experience on the battlefield.
scripts.translation: 这场考试最看重的，就是你在战场上积累的经验。

scripts.text: Therefore, what I request of you is to prove your power of survival.
scripts.translation: 因此，我要求你证明你的生存能力。

scripts.text: I want to see the real power of survival, even if you fall down and get beat up.
scripts.translation: 哪怕跌倒、挨打，也能活下来。我想看到的，就是这种真正的生存本领。

scripts.text: If you succeed with this survival power test, you will receive the first qualification.
scripts.translation: 如果你通过了这次生存能力考试，你将获得第一阶段的资格。

scripts.text: Well, let's talk about the details when you get the qualification for taking the test.
scripts.translation: 等你获得了参加考试的资格，我们再详细讨论。

scripts.text: When you want to take the survival power test, please talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 当你准备好参加生存能力考试时，请再来找我。

scripts.text: Before you change into a Ranger, I'll need to evaluate your pure abilities.
scripts.translation: 在转职为游侠之前，我要先评估你的真实实力。

scripts.text: To do this you need to be cleansed of body and soul.
scripts.translation: 要做到这一点，你需要净化身心。

scripts.text: Make sure that your weight equals 0 to continue.
scripts.translation: 请确保你的负重为0，以便继续。

scripts.text: Um. That you talked to me again means that you are determined to change into a Ranger and take the survival power test.
scripts.translation: 嗯。你再次来找我，说明你已下定决心转职为游侠，并接受生存能力测试。

scripts.text: Prepare yourself very well before taking this test.
scripts.translation: 在参加这次考试之前，请做好充分准备。

scripts.text: Think about it well and come back.
scripts.translation: 好好考虑一下，然后再回来。

scripts.text: If you are determined, then there's nothing to wait for.
scripts.translation: 如果你已经下定决心，那就没什么好犹豫的了。

scripts.text: What I'm going to provide you is 10 Fly Wings, 500 of Arrows and 1 test Bow.
scripts.translation: 我会给你10个苍蝇翅膀、500支箭和1把考试用弓。

scripts.text: Take the provided items and all you have to do for the survival power test is ^0000ffgo to the Northwestern area of Turtle Island and find Instructor Teardrop^000000.
scripts.translation: 带上发给你的物品，^0000ff前往海龟岛西北部，找到考试指导员 泪滴^000000，就算完成生存能力考试。

scripts.text: Remember that you don't have any other equipment on, so be careful of the monsters.
scripts.translation: 记住，你没有其他装备，所以要小心魔物。

scripts.text: What kind of preparation can be so long.
scripts.translation: 准备什么要花这么久啊？

scripts.text: Come again when you are absolutely ready.
scripts.translation: 等你完全准备好后再来。

scripts.text: Why did you bring so much?
It's good that you do your best on the job change but, the key to this test is to test our true abilities...
scripts.translation: 为转职全力以赴是好事，但这场考试要考的是你的真本事...

scripts.text: If you don't make your weight 0, you wouldn't be able to take the test.
scripts.translation: 如果你的负重不为0，你就无法参加考试。
再告诉我一次任务内容

scripts.text: Is this the mind of a person who's going to take the test?
scripts.translation: 这就是准备参加考试的人的心态吗？

scripts.text: Take the provided items and all you have to do for the survival power test is ^0000ffgo to the Northwestern area of Turtle Island and find Instructor Teardrop^000000.
scripts.translation: 带上发给你的物品，^0000ff前往海龟岛西北部，找到考试指导员 泪滴^000000，就算完成生存能力考试。

scripts.text: As you don't have any equipment on, be careful of the monsters in the field.
scripts.translation: 既然你没有装备，就要小心野外出现的魔物。

scripts.text: What kind of preparation can be so long.
scripts.translation: 准备什么要花这么久啊？

scripts.text: Come again when you are absolutely ready.
scripts.translation: 等你完全准备好后再来。

scripts.text: There's no time to hesitate, so do your best.
scripts.translation: 没有时间犹豫了，尽力而为。

scripts.text: I don't think you have the time for that.
scripts.translation: 我觉得你没时间做这种事。

scripts.text: Hurry up and finish the test.
Are you still wandering about here?
Well, if you are an easy person, that's none of my business but if you decided once, wouldn't it be better to take the practical test in a minute and meet me after becoming a Ranger?
scripts.translation: 你要是想悠闲度日，我也管不着。不过，既然已经下定决心，何不赶快去参加实战考试，等当上游侠再来见我？

scripts.text: Oh, hey. What are you doing here?
Because you've disappeared suddenly, the Ranger Master was looking for you.
scripts.translation: 因为你突然消失了，游侠大师一直在找你。

scripts.text: Do you want to go to him now?
Are you busy with something else?
Then I'll send you, please be well.
Next time, try not to intimidate other people.
scripts.translation: 下次，试着不要吓唬别人。

scripts.text: Next time, try not to intimidate other people.
scripts.translation: 下次，试着不要吓唬别人。

scripts.text: Huh? Who are you? What are you doing here, you baby archer.
scripts.translation: 咦？你是谁？小弓箭手，跑这儿来干什么？

scripts.text: May I tell you one thing?
If you want to change a job to a Ranger, first talk to Survival Instructor Rescue.
scripts.translation: 想转职为游侠的话，先去找生存测试导师救援者。

scripts.text: Then he will tell you the requirement for the job change test!!!
scripts.translation: 然后他会告诉你转职考试的要求！！！

scripts.text: Huh? Who are you? What are you doing here, you baby archer.
scripts.translation: 咦？你是谁？小弓箭手，跑这儿来干什么？

scripts.text: That you are coming and going bugs me so, would you please stop?!
scripts.translation: 别再晃来晃去的了，烦死人了！

scripts.text: What do you think you are looking at?
How could you be a Ranger if you can't even recognize what's in front of you? Get out of here!
scripts.translation: 连眼前的东西都认不出来，还想当游侠？滚开！

scripts.text: Ho, having come this far, it means you've passed the first survival test.
scripts.translation: 哟，能走到这里，说明你通过第一关生存考试了。

scripts.text: But, can you be sure that there wasn't any cheating?
scripts.translation: 但是，你能确定没有作弊吗？

scripts.text: Having done the test normally, you would have adjusted your weight to 0, and hold the items provided by Rescue!
scripts.translation: 按规矩，你应该先把负重清零，然后只带上救援发给你的物品来参加考试！

scripts.text: But, how come you weigh so much?
scripts.translation: 可你怎么会有这么高的负重？

scripts.text: I don't smell any signs of cheating. For now...
scripts.translation: 暂时还没闻到作弊的味道...

scripts.text: Before taking a practical test, I want to eat something.
scripts.translation: 开始实战考试之前，我想先吃点东西。

scripts.text: You know the food situation isn't always so good in a foreign land.
scripts.translation: 在这异乡，想吃顿好的可不容易啊。

scripts.text: I know that the very basic way to survive might be raising the strength of one's own body. But, I find that sending adventurers is easier for me.
scripts.translation: 生存的根本，或许是锻炼自己的体魄。不过我发现，差遣冒险者替我跑腿更省事。

scripts.text: So, kill ^0000ff1 Dragon Tail^000000 and bring me ^0000ff1 Wing of Dragonfly^000000.
scripts.translation: 去消灭^0000ff1只刺尾蜻蜓^000000，带回^0000ff1个蜻蜓的翅膀^000000给我。

scripts.text: If you run out of the provided items, we cannot support you more so take care.
scripts.translation: 发给你的物品要是用完了，我们可不会再补给，小心点。

scripts.text: Consider this as an extension of the survival power test.
scripts.translation: 就当这是生存能力考试的延续吧。

scripts.text: You've brought it! Let me see...
You don't seem to be hurt anywhere...
scripts.translation: 你看起来哪里都没受伤...

scripts.text: Good, for now you're qualified for the practical test.
scripts.translation: 很好，算你取得参加实战考试的资格了。

scripts.text: Well, before I explain, could you please give me that Dragonfly wing?
scripts.translation: 嗯，在我解释之前，能把那个蜻蜓翅膀给我吗？

scripts.text: You've heard the saying, 'in any situation, eating comes first'?
scripts.translation: 你听过那句“无论什么情况，吃饭第一”的话吧？

scripts.text: What are you doing there? Standing with a blank look.
scripts.translation: 你站在那里发什么呆呢？

scripts.text: Before taking the practical test, I want to eat something.
scripts.translation: 在进行实战考试之前，我想吃点东西。

scripts.text: I know that the very basic way to survive might be raising the strength of one's own body. But, I find that sending adventurers is easier for me.
scripts.translation: 生存的根本，或许是锻炼自己的体魄。不过我发现，差遣冒险者替我跑腿更省事。

scripts.text: So, kill ^0000ff1 Dragon Tail^000000 and bring me ^0000ff1 Dragon Fly Wing^000000.
scripts.translation: 去消灭^0000ff1只刺尾蜻蜓^000000，带回^0000ff1个蜻蜓的翅膀^000000给我。

scripts.text: If you run out of the provided items, we cannot support more so take care.
scripts.translation: 发给你的物品要是用完了，我们可不会再补给，小心点。

scripts.text: Consider this as an extension of the survival power test.
scripts.translation: 就当这是生存能力考试的延续吧。

scripts.text: Eh? What are you looking at?
If you cover it with rice, it's like roasted seaweed, very tasty and delicious.
scripts.translation: 如果配上米饭，就像烤海苔一样，非常美味。

scripts.text: You need to be strong enough not to be so picky with such things...
scripts.translation: 这点东西都挑三拣四的，可没法在野外生存啊...

scripts.text: Hmm? Oh my, oh my, I've shown you my sloppiness.
scripts.translation: 嗯？哎呀哎呀，让你见笑了。

scripts.text: Ok, I'll send you to the practical test field.
scripts.translation: 好了，我会把你送到实战考试场地。

scripts.text: The practical test consists of 3 parts in total.
scripts.translation: 实战考试总共分为3个部分。

scripts.text: It's to recheck the things you've learned as a hunter or a sniper, so there's nothing much to be worried.
scripts.translation: 这是为了重新检查你作为猎人或神射手所学到的东西，所以没什么好担心的。

scripts.text: If you get a passing mark over three tests, you'll be on your way to becoming a Ranger.
scripts.translation: 如果你在三次考试中都获得及格分数，你就将踏上成为游侠的道路。

scripts.text: I'll explain the paths for the test.
scripts.translation: 我来说明一下考试流程。

scripts.text: Once you get into the test field, a staff will be waiting for you. Go into the room made by the staff, and standby.
scripts.translation: 进入考场后，会有职员接待你。进他们开设的聊天室候考就行。

scripts.text: The test is done one by one so, if there's many people, you might need to wait.
scripts.translation: 考试是逐个进行的，如果人多，你可能需要等待。

scripts.text: The first test is to test of how keen your eyes are.
scripts.translation: 第一项考试是检验你的眼力。

scripts.text: Different monsters will appear in 8 places. Kill only the monster named 'Poring' and you get a point, when you reach a certain mark, then you pass. Easy, huh?
scripts.translation: 8个地点会出现不同的魔物，只击杀名为“波利”的魔物即可得分，达到一定分数即可通过。很简单吧？

scripts.text: The second test is about how much you can use a trap efficiently.
scripts.translation: 第二项考试，考的是你能否有效运用陷阱。

scripts.text: Get rid of monsters and do the mission by using only the provided traps, and you pass. Just be careful not to be engulfed by the explosion.
scripts.translation: 只能使用发给你的陷阱消灭魔物、完成任务，做到就算通过。小心别把自己也炸进去了。

scripts.text: For the 3rd test, when you become a Ranger you can handle a wolf, so you will be tested on how well you can handle such an animal.
scripts.translation: 游侠能够驾驭狼，所以第三项考试，就考你操控狼的本领。

scripts.text: When you remove a bomb by using the given wolf, you get points. You pass when you get a certain mark on the test.
scripts.translation: 使用提供的狼拆除炸弹即可得分。在考试中达到一定分数即可通过。

scripts.text: The staff there will tell you more details as well.
scripts.translation: 那里的职员也会告诉你更多细节。

scripts.text: Now, I will enter you into the practical test field, is your preparation all done?
scripts.translation: 现在，我将把你送入实战考试场地，你的准备都做好了吗？

scripts.text: Let's go to the practical test field!
Well. To be careful is good.
Come back when you are ready.
Why are you walking about here? What about the test?
scripts.translation: 你在这里走来走去做什么？考试呢？
啊哈...你在半道上失败了啊！

scripts.text: So what are you going to do? Try again?
scripts.translation: 那你打算怎么办？再试一次吗？

scripts.text: Go to the practical test field!
I give up the job change.
All right. To be careful is good.
Do you really want to give up the job change to become a Ranger?
scripts.translation: 你真的要放弃转职为游侠吗？

scripts.text: Hey. You were kidding after all?
scripts.translation: 嘿。原来你是在开玩笑啊？

scripts.text: It's not funny so don't do that kind of joke again.
scripts.translation: 这不好笑，别再开这种玩笑了。

scripts.text: You don't have as many guts as I thought.
scripts.translation: 你的胆量没我想象的那么大啊。

scripts.text: I'll cancel the job change request from {0}.
Huh? Where's the bow that I gave you for the practical tests?
scripts.translation: 咦？我发给你的用于实战考试的弓去哪了？

scripts.text: If you don't return it, I can't cancel you job change request.
scripts.translation: 如果不还给我，我就无法取消你的转职申请。

scripts.text: Oh, hey. What are you doing here?
Because you've disappeared suddenly, the Ranger Master was looking for you.
scripts.translation: 因为你突然消失了，游侠大师一直在找你。

scripts.text: Do you want to go to him now?
Are you busy with something else?
Then I'll send you, please be well.
scripts.translation: 那就去吧，祝你一切顺利。

scripts.text: It seems that your dull eyes became somewhat keen now?
scripts.translation: 看来你那迟钝的眼睛现在变得有点敏锐了？

scripts.text: Then, enjoy an adventure well as a Ranger.
scripts.translation: 那么，作为游侠好好享受冒险吧。

scripts.text: Huh? What are you? Where are you from?
scripts.translation: 咦？你是什么人？从哪里来的？

scripts.text: Don't hang around here doing nothing. This is my area!
scripts.translation: 别在这里闲逛。这是我的地盘！

scripts.text: Where do you think you're going with that mercenary?!
scripts.translation: 你想带着那个佣兵去哪？！

scripts.text: If you don't cancel the mercenary, you cannot get into the test field! Cancel it first!
scripts.translation: 带着佣兵可不能进考场！先解除佣兵契约！

scripts.text: What, what is this, a Bombring Capsule.
scripts.translation: 这、这是什么？炸弹波利胶囊？

scripts.text: You shouldn't keep such a dangerous thing!
scripts.translation: 这么危险的东西，不能带在身上！

scripts.text: What, what are all these Documents?
I think I know. You were going to send this to Caution, right?
scripts.translation: 我想我知道了。你是想把这个交给警戒，对吧？

scripts.text: If you hold such thing it would disturb your practical test so I'll take this.
scripts.translation: 持有这种东西会干扰你的实战考试，所以我把它收走了。
那么，我们出发吧...呃，等等？

scripts.text: Hey, what are you hiding there?
I've pointed it out for several times, you should not even think to go in there secretly with anything other than the provided items!
scripts.translation: 我都说了好几遍了，除了发给你的物品，别想偷偷带其他东西进去！

scripts.text: See, for the last time, I warn you that cheating is strictly banned.
scripts.translation: 听好了，最后一次警告你，严禁作弊。

scripts.text: Okay, once again I'll provide you with arrows, then I'll let you in.
scripts.translation: 好的，我再给你提供一次箭矢，然后让你进去。

scripts.text: Become a Ranger and we shall meet again.
scripts.translation: 成为游侠后，我们还会再见的。

scripts.text: Please wait at the practical test waiting room to start the test process.
scripts.translation: 请到实战考试候考室等待入场。

scripts.text: In the order you enter, you can take the practical test one by one.
scripts.translation: 考试按进入候考室的顺序逐人进行。

scripts.text: There's 3 kinds of a Ranger job change practical tests, it takes a total of about 10 minutes.
scripts.translation: 游侠转职实战考试共分3项，全程约需10分钟。

scripts.text: I give up the Ranger test
Enter into the chat room and wait for the order and take the job change practical test.
scripts.translation: 请进入聊天室，按顺序等待参加转职实战考试。

scripts.text: If you give up here, your job change request will be cancelled. Do you really want to give up the job change to a Ranger?
scripts.translation: 如果你在这里放弃，你的转职申请将被取消。你真的要放弃转职为游侠吗？

scripts.text: No, I'll continue with the test
I give up the Ranger job change
If you want to continue with the practical test, please enter into the chat room.
scripts.translation: 如果你想继续实战考试，请进入聊天室。

scripts.text: You don't have as many guts as I thought.
scripts.translation: 你的胆量没有我想象的那么大。
好的。我会尊重你的意见。

scripts.text: I'll cancel the job change request from {0}.
Huh? Where's the bow that I gave you for the practical tests?
scripts.translation: 咦？我发给你的用于实战考试的弓在哪里？

scripts.text: If you don't return it, I can't cancel you job change request.
scripts.translation: 如果不还给我，我就无法取消你的转职申请。

scripts.text: I'll explain the Ranger job change practical test.
scripts.translation: 我来说明游侠转职实战考试的内容。

scripts.text: Among the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd practical tests, which one's test method are you curious of?
scripts.translation: 你想了解哪一项考试的规则？

scripts.text: For the 1st test, we test your eyesight and accuracy.
scripts.translation: 第一项考试，考查眼力和准确度。

scripts.text: Monsters appear randomly from 8 sides of the left, right, up and down of the player, among them if you get rid of a monster named 'Poring' you get a point.
scripts.translation: 魔物会随机出现在考生周围的8个位置。击杀其中名为“波利”的魔物即可得分。

scripts.text: ^0000ffWhatever the form looks like, you need to kill the monster named 'Poring' to get a point, and if you get rid of others your points get deducted, so be careful.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff无论魔物呈现什么形态，你都需要消灭名为“波利”的魔物才能得分，如果消灭了其他魔物，分数会被扣除，所以请小心。^000000

scripts.text: The 1st test progressing time will be about 3 minutes. When you get 15 points or more over 20, you are sent to 2nd test field.
scripts.translation: 第一项考试限时约3分钟，满分20分，取得15分或以上即可进入第二项考试场地。

scripts.text: The 2nd test is to test the mission performance ability and the efficient use of a trap.
scripts.translation: 第二项考试，考查任务执行能力和陷阱运用技巧。

scripts.text: The attendant receives 10 'Bombring Capsules'. When you consume the Bombring Capsule, a Bombring is summoned near and after the summoning when you reach a certain time, the Bombring explodes.
scripts.translation: 考生会领到10个“炸弹波利胶囊”。使用后，会在附近召唤出一只炸弹波利，过一段时间它就会爆炸。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe Bombring explosion affects you, so be careful not to get involved in the explosion. You need to get rid of the monster by using the Bombring Capsule, accomplish the mission and come out alive.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff炸弹波利的爆炸会波及到你，所以请小心不要被卷入爆炸中。你需要使用炸弹波利胶囊消灭魔物，完成任务并活着离开。^000000

scripts.text: The 2nd test progressing time will be about 3 minutes. When you consume all the Bombring Capsules, collect hidden equipment, and survive, you will be sent to the 3rd test field.
scripts.translation: 第二项考试的持续时间约为3分钟。当你用完所有炸弹波利胶囊，收集隐藏装备并存活下来，就会被传送到第三项考试场地。

scripts.text: The 3rd is to test how you can efficiently use a wolf which is given Rangers.
scripts.translation: 第三项考试，考查你能否有效操控游侠的伙伴——狼。

scripts.text: The tester is provided with disposable wolf summoning flute. Remove all bombs that are dispersed here and there by controlling the summoned warg and you get a point.
scripts.translation: 考生会领到一支一次性召狼笛。操控召唤出的狼，清除四处出现的炸弹即可得分。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe tester cannot move while the test is going on and the test is completed when he or she removes the bombs quickly and accurately in time by using only the warg.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff考试期间考生无法移动，必须只操控狼，在限定时间内迅速、准确地清除炸弹，才能完成考试。^000000

scripts.text: The 3rd test progressing time would be about 3 minutes, when you get 10 or more over 20, all the practical tests are completed.
scripts.translation: 第三项考试限时约3分钟，满分20分，取得10分或以上即可完成全部实战考试。

scripts.text: When you want to progress with the practical test, please enter into the chat room.
scripts.translation: 如果你想继续实战考试，请进入聊天室。
我会给你“炸弹波利胶囊”。

scripts.text: The 'Bombring Capsules' can be given again only for the one who used it all, so please keep that in mind.
scripts.translation: 只有用完所有胶囊的人才能再次领取，请记好这一点。

scripts.text: And the mission is.... to deliver these documents to the supervisor, Caution. He won't take what I give...
scripts.translation: 任务内容是...把这些文件交给主管 警戒。但他不会接受我送的东西...

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but you already have the 'Bombring Capsules', so I cannot provide you with more.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，您已经持有“炸弹波利胶囊”，所以我无法再提供给您。

scripts.text: Excuse me, but how did you get in?
If you are not here for the job change test, please leave.
scripts.translation: 如果您不是来参加转职考试的，请离开。

scripts.text: You need to use all the 'Bombring Capsules'?!
scripts.translation: 你得先把“炸弹波利胶囊”全部用完！

scripts.text: Use it all and come back!
Time is ticking so you'd better hurry.
Mr. Rust asked me to give this to you.
scripts.translation: 拉斯特先生让我把这个交给您

scripts.text: I've been avoiding him so much!!
scripts.translation: 我明明一直在躲着他啊！！

scripts.text: I've never imagined this could be a test...
scripts.translation: 我从未想过这竟然是一场考试...

scripts.text: Anyway you've passed the 2nd test very well.
scripts.translation: 总之，你非常顺利地通过了第二项考试。

scripts.text: Pass the 3rd one and you will become a great ranger.
scripts.translation: 通过第三项考试，你就会成为一名优秀的游侠。
拉斯特没给你什么东西吗？

scripts.text: Congrats for passing the 2nd practical test! I am the 3rd practical test supervisor Freeze!
scripts.translation: 恭喜通过第二项实战考试！我是第三项考试的监督，冰冻！

scripts.text: For the 3rd test, I'll test how much you could use a wolf effectively. When you become a Ranger in the future, you'll learn an wolf!
scripts.translation: 第三项考试，考查你操控狼的本领。将来成为游侠后，你就能驯养狼了！

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe tester is provided with a disposable Wolf summoning Flute! When you remove egg bombs coming out from here and there by controlling the summoned wolf, you get points!^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff考生会领到一支一次性召狼笛！操控召唤出的狼，清除四处出现的蛋形炸弹即可得分！^000000

scripts.text: Tester cannot move during the test, and the test completes when all bombs are removed quickly and accurately within the given time only by using a wolf!
scripts.translation: 考试期间考生无法移动！必须只操控狼，在限定时间内迅速、准确地清除炸弹，才能完成考试！

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe way to control an wolf is to press the alt key and left-click the surface, then the wolf moves to the point where you've clicked on!^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff按住Alt键，用鼠标左键点击地面，狼就会移动到指定位置！^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffWhen you target the bomb and press one more, it starts to attack!^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff瞄准炸弹，再点击一次，就会开始攻击！^000000

scripts.text: The 3rd test time limit is about 3 minutes, when you get 10 over 20 points, you can pass the practical test!
scripts.translation: 第三项考试限时约3分钟，满分20分，得到10分或以上即可通过！

scripts.text: Well, then first get this Wolf' flutes and after summoning the wolf, talk to me!
scripts.translation: 那么，先拿好这支狼笛，召唤出狼后再来找我！

scripts.text: Good! Then I'll start the test right now!
scripts.translation: 很好！那我现在就开始测试！

scripts.text: Keep in mind! You need to remove the egg bomb before it gets exploded by only using a wolf!
scripts.translation: 记住！只能操控狼，在蛋形炸弹爆炸之前将其清除！

scripts.text: Huh?! There's no wolf, no Test Flute, where did you get rid of them?!
scripts.translation: 咦？！狼和测试笛子都不见了，你把它们弄到哪里去了？！

scripts.text: I'll give you one more time specially, so hold yourself together!
scripts.translation: 我特别再给你一次机会，所以请振作起来！

scripts.text: Summon the wolf quickly, and talk to me again!
scripts.translation: 快召唤狼，然后再来找我！

scripts.text: Play the Test Flute quickly to summon the wolf and talk to me!
scripts.translation: 快吹响测试笛召唤狼，然后来找我！

scripts.text: This area is for the Ranger Job Change test!
scripts.translation: 这里是游侠转职考试区域！

scripts.text: You are not authorized to be here, please get out!
scripts.translation: 你没有权限待在这里，请离开！

scripts.text: It's weird... How did you get here?
You don't seem to belong here...
You are not supposed to be here.
I can tell just by looking at you that you seem to be inexperienced.
scripts.translation: 我一看就知道你似乎缺乏经验。

scripts.text: Have more pride in your job and get more experience, and then when you grow as a Hunter or a Sniper you can make an aura by yourself, please come back again.
scripts.translation: 拿出身为猎人或神射手的自豪，多积累些经验。等你练到满级，身上散发出光环时，再来找我吧。

scripts.text: You've completed all the rough practical tests!
scripts.translation: 你已经完成所有实战测试了！

scripts.text: Well, you've had enough experience so I won't need to drag on.
scripts.translation: 既然你已经积累了足够的经验，我就不啰嗦了。

scripts.text: Before you do a job change ^0000ffdismiss your Falcon^000000, and check if you've used all of your ^0000ffSkill Points^000000.
scripts.translation: 在转职之前，^0000ff收回你的猎鹰^000000，并确认是否已经用完了所有的^0000ff技能点^000000。

scripts.text: I am not running away so take your time.
Please dismiss your falcon, and come back to me.
scripts.translation: 请收回你的猎鹰，然后回来找我。

scripts.text: I think you need to learn more.
scripts.translation: 我觉得你还需要多学习。

scripts.text: Use up all of your skill points before continuing on.
scripts.translation: 在继续之前，请用完所有的技能点。

scripts.text: Good. No falcon and you've used up all your skill points.
scripts.translation: 很好。你没有带猎鹰，而且已经用完了所有技能点。

scripts.text: Okay, before you really change the job into a ranger, I'll ask you on more time.
scripts.translation: 好吧，在你真正转职为游侠之前，我要再问你一次。

scripts.text: Do you really want to become a ranger?
...Um? That's not the answer that I was waiting for...
Even after passing through all the rough practical tests, you don't want to become a ranger... are you sure?
scripts.translation: 即使通过了所有艰难的实战考试，你也不想成为游侠...你确定吗？

scripts.text: You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation: 请先解除骑乘状态，再试一次！

scripts.text: You are not a Hunter or a Sniper?!
You are not supposed to be here. Get out!
Your firm answer seems very trustworthy!
scripts.translation: 你的坚定回答听起来很可信！

scripts.text: You need to return the borrowed stuff.
scripts.translation: 你需要归还借用的物品。

scripts.text: Where is the bow that was given to you for the job change test?
scripts.translation: 用于转职考试的那把弓在哪里？

scripts.text: From now on be active as a splendid Ranger!
scripts.translation: 今后就以游侠的身份，好好大显身手吧！

scripts.text: I wish you luck in your future!
Well, there's nothing to see and you came.
scripts.translation: 这里又没什么好看的，你还特地跑来啊。

scripts.text: Take a rest as long as you want.
It's the place where you can have a tea easily.
scripts.translation: 在这儿悠闲地喝杯茶吧。

scripts.text: It was good to see you.
Don't lose the dignity as a Ranger wherever you go.
scripts.translation: 无论去往何处，都不要失去游侠的尊严。
